description: Hand-written retrieval evaluation set. Each question has exactly one relevant source document, verified to contain the answer. Questions are grouped so that several in each department can only be answered by one of two similar documents (annual vs quarterly), which is where reranking is expected to matter most.
relevance: One relevant document per question. Recall@k therefore equals hit-rate@k.
